content:
incident-bot: 🔔 INCIDENT detected — p99 latency spike on dedicated-pool-7 (eu-west-1). Auto-page -> @alex (oncall). Metric alert: service=dapi/serve, p99 > 6.0s for 3m. Queue depth rising. Streaming stalls observed.

alex: on it, acked. jumping into dashboards.

alex: quick snapshot: p95=0.9s, p99=6.8s, avg queue depth=84, inflight streams stalled=23. Seeing sustained enqueue rate ~120rps.

alex: PromQL snippets:```
sum(rate(dapi_request_duration_seconds_bucket[1m])) by (le)
# p99 approx from histogram: 6.8s
avg_over_time(dedicated_pool_queue_depth[5m]) = 84
count_over_time(streaming_conn_stall_total[5m]) = 23
```

oncall-note: routing policy currently prefers dedicated variant; fallback is disabled for this pool.

mike: jumping in — checking autoscaler logs. We have a backlog of warmup handshakes failing during burst. Autoscaler triggered scale-up at +90s but new slots entered "limbo" due to runtime handshake timeout (10s) and image pulls peaked.

mike: logs:```
[2026-03-15T10:05:12Z] pod/dedicated-7-54 attempt=1 handshake_timeout after 10s
[2026-03-15T10:05:18Z] kubelet: image pull queued, concurrency=12, registry latency spike
[2026-03-15T10:05:45Z] runtime: kv-cache miss, kickoff warmup, not serving streams until ready
```

emily-sre: summary so far — root cause appears to be autoscaler + image-pull contention -> warm replicas slow to become ready -> queue depth grows -> streaming tail latency spikes.

emily-sre: immediate mitigations: 1) enable fallback routing to hosted-small for non-sensitive tenants, 2) manual scale: pre-warm 6 reserved hot replicas in pool, 3) temporarily increase handshake timeout to 20s to avoid aborts.

alex: I kicked the manual scale job:```
./infra/scale_pool --pool dedicated-pool-7 --reserve 6 --type hotshot --reason "incident: cold attach"
```

deploy-bot: scale job accepted — 6 hotshots scheduled. ETA ~45s.

mike: also opened a short-term registry concurrency throttle to reduce image-pull stalls. Applied patch to nodepool imagePull limit.

incident-bot: routing change applied for non-enterprise tenants -> ~40% traffic routed to hosted-fallback.

luis-csm: any customer impact? I'm seeing elevated error rates for two customers: AcmeCorp (high volume async embeddings) and FinanceOne (chat streaming tail errors). What should we tell them?

alex: AcmeCorp: errors ~2.4% of requests (retries succeed on fallback). FinanceOne: streaming stalls for ~0.8% of sessions, mainly p99 tail. No data loss; some sessions experienced timeouts and reconnects.

luis-csm: drafting proactive note: "We're experiencing elevated latency due to infrastructure warmup delays; we've applied fallbacks and manual pre-warms. We'll follow up with RCA and ETA for permanent fixes." Will share drafts in #customer-updates.

sara: I'm coming onshift — 1 minute handoff pls.

alex: handing off to @sara — current state: manual pre-warm in progress (6 hotshots), fallback routing enabled, p99 trending down from 6.8s -> 3.2s in last 2m. Active work items: verify image-pull concurrency, increase reserved warm replicas, postmortem ticket with timeline.

sara: acked, taking over. I'll own communication and coordination. Going to monitor p95/p99 and watch streaming stall counts.

mike: hotshots are Ready. New replicas accepted the model bundle. Handshake success rate jumped from 60% -> 98%.

alex: p99 now 1.9s, p95 0.7s, queue depth down to 12, streaming stalls down to 2.

incident-bot: INCIDENT update — mitigation in place, metrics improved. Auto-alert still open for monitoring.

sara: marking incident as mitigated for now — will keep monitoring for 30m. Actions to create:
- follow-up ticket: INFRA-1109 "Reserved warm replicas + autoscaler backoff tuning" (assigned to mike)
- playbook update: enable fallback for mixed-traffic pools during burst (assigned to emily-sre)
- infra change: increase image-pull concurrency limits in eu-west nodepool (assigned to infra team)

sara: preliminary RCA: bursty traffic caused many concurrent image pulls + handshake timeouts; autoscaler reaction latency + restrictive fallback policy allowed queue buildup and streaming tail degradation.

luis-csm: thanks — I'll send the customer note: "We applied routing fallback and pre-warmed capacity; latency is back to normal and we expect no data loss. Full RCA coming."

sara: handoff complete. tagging this as triaged, mitigated -> monitoring. Will reopen if p99 > 3s. :white_check_mark:
